owner.soNotePh: For example one stand is bent
owner.soDoneText: You said it arrived fine on {a}. Thank you.

owner.soWait: We will tell you when it is on the way.
owner.soToastBad: Report sent. We will call you.
owner.lgStandProb: Reported a problem with stand order {a}
owner.attnStandSub: Order {a} · tell us it is here
owner.plTrialText: The trial ends on {a}. After that the plan costs {b} a year.
owner.plDueText: Please pay {a} by {b}. Your shop keeps working while we wait.
owner.plNextText: You can pay for the next year from {a}. The new year counts from {b} and ends on {c}.
owner.plExtra: Each branch after the 2nd adds {a} a year.
owner.plHowText: Pay by Telebirr, CBE Birr, cash or bank. Tell us, and we write it here. This is done by hand, so please allow one working day.
owner.ibHelp: News and answers from the Temelash team.
owner.mrHelp: Everything you asked us to do, and what happened.

admin.searchPh: Find a business, agent or request
admin.siSub: Temelash Admin is for the Temelash team only.
admin.wrong: Email, password or code is not right.
admin.otpSub: Open your authenticator app, for example Google Authenticator, and type the code for Temelash Admin. We ask for a code every time you sign in.
admin.bkSub: Type one of the backup codes you saved. Each code works only once.
admin.bkWrong: That backup code is not right or was used already.
admin.s1Sub: Step 1 of 2. Scan the square with Google Authenticator, or type the key in by hand. Then type the 6-digit code it shows.
admin.s2Sub: Step 2 of 2. If you lose your phone, each code lets you in once. We keep only a scrambled copy (a hash), so we can never show these again. Save them somewhere safe, like a password manager or a printed page.
admin.lockedSub: Too many wrong tries. For safety, it opens again in {a} minutes. If this was not you, tell the other admin.
admin.idleSub: There was no activity for {a} minutes, so we ended your session to keep the data safe.
admin.rule1: A code from your phone is needed every time
admin.rule2: {a} wrong tries lock sign-in for {b} minutes
admin.rule3: Sessions end after {a} minutes of no activity
admin.barsNote: Sign-ups by the date they joined.
admin.bzSearch: Search name, owner, phone or city
admin.noteBizPaused: This business is paused. Staff and customers cannot add stamps. Cards stay safe.
admin.noteBizPending: Waiting for our check. Staff and customers cannot use it yet.
admin.noteBizClosing: Closing approved. Until then everything keeps working.
admin.pauseBizS: Stops all stamping. Use for unpaid or misuse.
admin.seeCustomersS: {a} on this shop list. Pause cards.
admin.whatToDo: What do you need to do?
admin.teamFoot: We only show names and roles. Stamping details stay with the owner.
admin.cuSearch: Search a customer by name or phone
admin.cuFoot: Showing {a} of {b}. Phone numbers are partly hidden.

admin.pauseCardS: Lost phone, misuse or the customer asked
admin.resumeCardS: The customer can collect stamps again
admin.noteTitle: Add a note (only the Temelash team can see it)
admin.notePh: For example: owner asked us to call after 4 pm
admin.rqSub: {a} open · what owners and customers asked us to do
admin.rqPick: Pick a request on the left to see what to check and what you can do.
admin.tapAssign: Tap to change who handles this
admin.agentMismatch: The owner typed {a} but no agent has this number. It may be a typing mistake. Call the owner, or link an agent below.
admin.chk1: I called the owner and they answered
admin.chk2: The shop is real (I visited, or saw a photo of the shop)
admin.chk3: The phone number is confirmed (SMS code worked)
admin.chkAgent: Agent {a} confirmed they enrolled this shop
admin.chkTick: Tick each one when you have done it.
admin.approveStartS: Choose a trial or a free pilot next
admin.signalV: {a} stamps in one hour on one phone
admin.calledOwnerS: Adds a note for the team
admin.pauseFlagS: Stops all stamping while we look
admin.calledNote: Called the owner about unusual activity.
admin.approveSub: They can start stamping right away.
admin.planAfter: Plan they will pay for after the trial
admin.noAgentNote: No agent: no commission to pay.
admin.rejectSub: The owner gets a text with the reason. They can sign up again later.
admin.noteOptPh: Add a short note for the log
admin.assignNote: They see it first in their list. Anyone can still open it.
admin.pauseSub: Staff and customers cannot add stamps while paused. Cards and stamps stay safe.
admin.pauseNote: The owner is told their account is paused and who to call.
admin.resumeSub: Stamping starts working again for staff and customers.
admin.cpSub: They cannot collect or use stamps until you resume it.
admin.cpNote: The yearly fee changes. Already paid this year: {a}.
admin.dmSub: It will be marked as looked at. It can come back if it happens again.
admin.lgSub: Everything we do on an account is written here. Nobody can edit or delete it.
admin.subRules: The rules behind what we promise owners and agents. Changes are written to the activity log.
admin.subTeam: Who can use Admin and what they can do.
admin.subSafety: The emergency switch and when we raise flags.
admin.subAccount: Your own sign-in and security. Every change is written to the activity log.
admin.pExtraS: After the 2 branches in the Full plan
admin.commission: Agent commission, net (confirm the extra branch amount)
admin.cmPaid: Paid when the business has paid
admin.govPctS: Added on top of each commission
admin.ownerOnly: Only an Owner can change this.
admin.perm4: Pay agents and mark the government share
admin.twoOwnersNote: Keep at least two Owners. If one loses their phone and backup codes, the other approves the reset.
admin.bkCodesV: Shown once, kept as a hash
admin.invSub: They get a temporary password, shown once. On first sign-in they set up an authenticator app.
admin.rolesList2: Finance: payments, agent payouts, government share, money files
admin.rolesList3: Support: businesses, requests and messages, no money
admin.tempSub: Shown once. Give it to them yourself; they set up the authenticator at first sign-in.
admin.emailUsed: That email is already on the team.
admin.roleSelf: You cannot change your own role. Ask another Owner.
admin.roleNote: The change works the next time they open a page.
admin.off1: They are signed out everywhere now
admin.off2: Their history stays in the activity log
admin.stampingPaused: Stamping is paused for every business
admin.killOnS: For emergencies only. Needs your authenticator code.
admin.killNote: Pausing stops every stamp and reward for every business. Cards and stamps stay safe. Owners and customers see your message. To pause one business only, open it and use Pause.
admin.flagsTitle: When we raise an unusual-activity flag
admin.flagHour: Stamps in one hour on one phone
admin.flagHourS: Above this we raise a flag
admin.flagsNote: Flags show in Requests under Flags. Lower numbers catch more but also raise more false alarms.
admin.kmOnSub: For every business. Use this only if something is badly wrong.
admin.kmOffSub: Every business can add stamps again.
admin.kmWhyPh: For example: a wrong stamp spike on one phone
admin.kmMsgDefault: We are fixing a problem. Stamping is paused for a short time. Your stamps are safe.
admin.km1: No one can add stamps or use rewards
admin.km3: Owners see a message in the app
admin.authAppS: A 6-digit code is asked every time you sign in
admin.exSub: Exports hold private data, so we check it is really you. We ask every time, even if you just signed in.
admin.exPii: Has phone numbers and names. Keep the file safe.
admin.exMoney: Money figures only, no personal data.
admin.exNote: The export is written to the activity log with your name and the time.
admin.finSub: Year {a} · Hamle 1 to {b} · tracked by hand
admin.fFoot: A payment covers the year up to Sene 30, even if the business joins later in the year.
admin.nothingDueSoon: Nothing due in the next days.
admin.paymentsFoot: Payments are recorded by hand. Tap a payment to see the receipt, correct the amount or reverse it.
admin.rpS: Telebirr, CBE Birr, cash or bank
admin.rpNote: This payment covers the year up to Sene 30, {a} ({b}). Balance now: {c}.
admin.abStarter: The Starter plan has 1 branch. A second branch moves them to the Full plan: {a} a year.
admin.abFull: Each branch after the second adds {a} a year.
admin.abPilot: Free pilot: no change to the fee.
admin.whatDo: What do you want to do?
admin.nothingToDo: Nothing to do: this payment was reversed.
admin.rcTaxNote: Check with your accountant whether receipts must show tax details or a fiscal number. This page shows what we record today.
admin.pcNote: The balance and the agent commission are worked out again. The first amount stays on the receipt as history.
admin.prS: If it should not have been recorded
admin.prNote: The balance comes back. The receipt stays on file marked as reversed. If we already paid the agent for this business, tell them.
admin.agSub: People who bring in businesses. These are records only. Agents do not sign in.
admin.agClickOwed: Click to see who to pay
admin.agFoot: A deal is a company an agent brought in. Commission is earned when the company has paid for the year.
admin.apSub: Every company they are owed for will be marked as paid.
admin.apNote: This only records the payout. It does not send money. Set aside {a} for the government, so the full cost is {b}.
admin.aaSub: This is a record for tracking only. Agents do not get a sign-in.
admin.aaPhone: Phone (owners type this when they sign up)
admin.aaNote: Agents are records only. They do not sign in. Commission follows the price list in Settings.
admin.adSub: Link a company to the agent who brought it.
admin.adNewPhone: Owner phone (linked when this phone signs up)
admin.adNote: Commission is earned when the company has paid for the year.
admin.noDeals: No deals yet. Tap Add deal.
admin.dealsFoot: Tap a company to open it. Tap a company that is not registered to link it once it signs up.
admin.llSub: The owner phone was {a}. Pick the company once it has signed up.
admin.netFoot: Amounts in Birr, net to the agent.
admin.payoutsFoot: Every payout you mark as paid is added here with the date and who recorded it.
admin.netNote: The agent receives the net amount. The government share is a cost to Temelash and is not taken from the agent.
admin.lbSub: Who is registering the most businesses. Counted from the day each business registered.
admin.lbFoot: “Before” is the same number of days just before this period. Agents with the same number share a rank. Deals not registered yet are not counted.
admin.rptSub: Year {a} · revenue, agent commission and the {b}% government share on each commission.
admin.monthsFoot: Amounts in Birr. Months are Ethiopian months. Commission is counted in the month the business paid.
admin.byAgentFoot: Commission each agent earned this year.
admin.govFoot: Handed over {a} · still to hand over {b}. Tap a month to write down that you paid it.
admin.govExample: Example: a 5,000 Birr commission adds {a} Birr for the government, so it costs {b} Birr in total. Change the percentage in Settings.
admin.gmSub: Write down that you paid the government share for this month.
admin.gmRefPh: For example the bank slip number
admin.gmNote: This only records it. It does not send money.
admin.gmUndoNote: Only undo this if it was marked by mistake.

inbox.pausedB: Temelash paused {a}: {b}. Staff and customers cannot add stamps until we resume it. Cards and stamps stay safe. Please call us.
inbox.receiptB: Thank you. We received {a} by {b} on {c} for year {d}. Receipt number {e}.
admin.msgSub: What we send to owners. They read it in the app, under Messages from Temelash.

admin.mcSub: Owners get it in the app.

admin.moNote: It shows in Messages from Temelash, and as a text message if you choose.

admin.moVerify: Hello {a}, we need to check a few details to finish setting up {b}. Please call us today.

admin.remindText: Your Temelash Card payment for {a} is due: {b}. Please pay by Telebirr or at our office. Thank you.
